title: hermes --launcher raycast output
description: Frozen contract for `hermes search|all|open --launcher raycast` (docs/adr/0005-raycast-extension-architecture.md). Structurally validates internal/launcher/raycast/render.go's output; internal/launcher/raycast/testdata/search_basic.json is the byte-identity golden fixture for one concrete example.

actions.description: Empty when hermes couldn't locate a launchable binary for this item.

binary.description: Absolute path to the JetBrains binary.

path.description: Absolute project path (same as the parent item's subtitle).

isModernBinary.description: true: launch via `open -na <binary> --args <path>` (post-2023 DMG layout). false: exec `<binary> <path>` directly.
